Excerpts from the Piedmont Police Department Log

PPD Blue

Piedmont Post · October 7, 2026 · 3 min read

Sept. 25 - Oct. 2

The Week by the Numbers

1 Residential Burglary 1 Fraud Report 2 Vandalism Report 3 ALPRs triggered (Automatic

License Plate Readers) 4 Automotive Burglaries 4 Arrests

Friday, September 25

5:07 p.m. Muir Ave. Report of skunk on side of house. Skunk captured and released.

6:37 p.m. Grand Ave. Arrest. ALPR triggered by stolen 2009 Ford Escape. Officer locates vehicle, occupant arrested for possession of stolen vehicle and taken to Santa Rita Jail.

Saturday, September 26

7:31 a.m. Lower Grand Ave. Report of alarm sounding since 4 a.m. Faulty smoke detector in truck; detector silenced.

3:41 p.m. Crocker Ave. Multiple reports of peaceful protest.

8:44 p.m. Wildwood Ave. Arrest. Report of man with backpack and flashlight in park rifling around. Officer finds person in triangle park area sitting on park bench. Person has outstanding warrants for DUI. Search finds narcotics with intent to distribute and paraphernalia. Suspect arrested and taken to Santa Rita Jail.

Sunday, September 27

4:34 p.m. Wildwood Ave. Report of vehicle crashing into tree. Occupant has minor injuries; vehicle towed.

Monday, September 28

8:48 a.m. Grand Ave. Fraud. Report of identity theft; email hacked.

1:09 p.m. Grand Ave. Report of man spitting at customers. Officer on scene, person refuses services and leaves premises.

3:19 p.m. Grand Ave. Arrest. Report of man without shirt disturbing the peace out front of Ace Hardware. Officers find intoxicated man stumbling and smelling of alcohol. Man identified and found to have warrants out of San Francisco County for sex offender registration, trespassing and vandalism. Man arrested and taken to Santa Rita Jail.

Tuesday, September 29

10:58 a.m. King Ave. Auto Burglary. Report of window smashed on parked vehicle. Vehicle rifled through; unknown loss.

2:37 p.m. Manor Dr. Officer locates stolen unoccupied black 2016 Mercedes. Vehicle stolen from Albany; owner notified.

3:12 p.m. Farragut Ave. ALPR triggered by blue Hyundai Sonata. Officer locates vehicle unoccupied. Officer attempts to contact owner.

8:43 p.m. Boulevard Way. Auto Burglary. Report of Kia Sorento rifled through. Vehicle parked in driveway. Coins and umbrella taken.

Wednesday, September 30

11:51 a.m. Hillside Ave. Auto Burglary. Report of rear plate stolen from Honda CRV.

4:03 p.m. Grand Ave. Report of dog biting a squirrel. Squirrel injured but runs away.

4:41 p.m. Fairview Ave. Report of Amazon truck speeding.

Thursday, October 1

7:41 a.m. Highland Ave. Bullets turned into PD for destruction on 9/24.

7:52 a.m. Howard Ave. Vandalism. Report of graffiti on Oakland Ave, bridge. Transient woman has green marker in her hand. Officer locates person; she is taken to hospital.

8:30 a.m. Lakeshore Ave. ALPR triggered by blue 2008 Toyota Tundra. Vehicle wanted for previously evading police as sideshow spectator.

9:10 a.m. Winsor Ave. Auto Burglary. Report of Honda Odyssey rifled through. No loss and no damage.

6:33 p.m. Highland Ave. Fire. Report of smoke coming from second floor of residence. Person fell asleep while cooking. Food taken off heat. Officer helps with ventilation of residual smoke.

Friday, October 2

1:15 a.m. Monticello Ave. Arrest. Report of two people in verbal argument. Officer on scene, one subject found to be on probation out of Sacramento County for possession of drugs, a stolen vehicle and burglary. Officers find person to be in possession of narcotics and drug paraphernalia. Person arrested for violation of probation terms and taken to Santa Rita Jail, Rejected at jail & transported to hospital.

6:16 a.m. Cambridge Way. Vandalism. Report of attempted catalytic converter theft. Converter cut but not removed.

8:41 a.m. Somerset Rd. Residential Burglary. Report of home under construction broken into overnight. Tools stolen.

Pick of the Week

  • Found bound hound

sound Monday, September 28

4:19 p.m. Grand Ave.

Report of large gray and white dog howling. Dog stuck between dividing wall. Unknown how long dog has been stuck. Dog freed, call canceled.
